thread: elaine: FYI on Console > Models table (compact rows) — the right-side kebab/favorite icons feel risky. tapped the kebab but hit the row behind it and opened the model. toby: ugh same. compact spacing + the action-strip sits over the row clickable zone. which browser? elaine: mac safari + chrome. happens when you try to quickly hit the icon. nina: i'd rather not touch global spacing tokens (they're used everywhere). can we do a local hit-area tweak for the action buttons? sam: options: 1) invisible pseudo element to widen hit area (no visual change), 2) increase internal padding but visually crop with negative margins, 3) make the row ignore pointer events when cursor is over action-strip. Prefer 1 or 2. elaine: option 1 sounds safest. also need keyboard nav — tabbing should still reach the icon. toby: quick CSS prototype (pseudo-element): ```css .action-btn::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -6px; /* expands hit area */ } .action-btn { position: relative; } ``` Keep visual size same but tap target grows. nina: good. mobile/touch note: ensure min 44px tap target; if visual icon smaller, increase pseudo inset only on touch media queries. sam: accessibility/copy nit: toasts currently read just "Saved" which is ambiguous when multiple saves happen. recommend contextual messages and ARIA labeling. e.g. `aria-live="polite"` and visible message "Model saved" with hidden detail: `Model: v2.1` if needed. elaine: saw a failure where two queued toasts both said "Saved" and NVDA announced the same thing twice, confusing users. we should include resource type or action. design-bot: suggested toast copy patterns: ["Model saved", "Policy saved", "Settings updated"]. For generic confirmation include a short noun. Use aria-live="polite" for success and assertive for errors. Provide visually hidden context when multiple items could be ambiguous. toby: action items: nina to ship pseudo-element hit-area patch with touch-media fallback; sam to update toast copy variants + aria patterns; I will add a tiny e2e (cypress) to click action vs row and assert no navigation. nina: will prototype and post screenshots + mobile simulator results by Wed. nina: quick question 0: if we add the pseudo-element, do we need pointer-events: none on it? otherwise it might block focus? sam: make pseudo-element `pointer-events: none` and rely on the actual button receiving events. That expands hit area visually for touch but doesn't change focus outline. For touch, ensure the button itself has larger hit area on touch UA. elaine: thanks team. tagging @frontend. design-bot: summary: expand action button hit area locally (pseudo-element or internal padding) w/ touch fallback to 44px; keep spacing tokens unchanged; make toast copy contextual and ensure aria-live semantics. :white_check_mark:
